aluminum_potential_file_subtask_quenchin.name: Aluminum Potential File for Quenching
aluminum_potential_file_subtask_quenchin.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Aluminum for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

aluminum_npt_cooling_subtask_quenching.name: Aluminum NPT Cooling
aluminum_npt_cooling_subtask_quenching.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible molten Aluminum structure and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate quenching process of Aluminum by cooling its molten structure under NPT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Return the absolute path of the cooled structure and the density in gm/cm^3.
aluminum_npt_cooling_subtask_quenching.submission_format: {"density": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"density": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/structure.dat"}

aluminum_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenchin.name: Aluminum NPT Relaxation for Quenching
aluminum_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenchin.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Aluminum structure and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, relax the structure under NPT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Return the absolute path of the equilibrated structure and density in gm/cm^3.
aluminum_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenchin.submission_format: {"density": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"density": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/structure.dat"}

aluminum_nvt_relaxation_subtask_quenchin.name: Aluminum NVT Relaxation for Quenching
aluminum_nvt_relaxation_subtask_quenchin.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Aluminum structure and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, relax the structure under NVT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Report the final density in g/cm^3.
